title: Reading Drill — Evaluating discounts at a cinema — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Evaluating discounts at a cinema — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Foxhaven began with reports of popular screenings still having empty seats after booking. The cinema manager had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using ticket scans and chose the share of reservations used as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was same-day reminders. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted seven weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded last-minute film changes as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
